description: Search Corollary's catalogue of open scientific AI models (protein structure prediction, protein design, docking, antibodies, genomics, single-cell, chemistry/ADMET, simulation, pathology, weather), bioinformatics programs (BUSCO, samtools, BLAST…), scientific databases (UniProt, PDB, gnomAD…), nf-core pipelines and datasets. Each result says what it does, its licence and whether it can be run online on Corollary with no GPU or installation, with the page URL. Use it when a user asks which model or tool to use for a biology or chemistry task, or where to run one.

kind.description: Restrict to one kind. Default: any.

query.description: Name or task, e.g. 'ESMFold', 'protein-ligand binding affinity', 'phage annotation'.

name: search_scientific_ai
title: Search scientific AI models, tools, databases, pipelines and datasets
